info.name: redis-token-management
info.description:
Redis & Spring Security Token Management API

This collection contains all HTTP endpoints for the redis-token-management Spring Boot application, including authentication endpoints for user registration, login, logout, and JWT token refresh.

**Base URL:** Use the `{{baseUrl}}` variable to configure the server host.

request.description:
Home endpoint that returns a welcome message.

**Controller:** HomeController
**Method:** home()

**Response:** Welcome message string

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Register a new user in the system.

**Controller:** AuthController
**Method:** registerNewUser(RegisterRequest)

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required): The username for the new user
- `password` (string, required): The password for the new user

**Response:** AuthenticationResponse containing access and refresh tokens

Authenticate an existing user and return JWT tokens.

**Controller:** AuthController
**Method:** login(LoginRequest)

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required): The username of the user
- `password` (string, required): The password of the user

**Response:** AuthenticationResponse containing access and refresh tokens

Logout the currently authenticated user by removing their tokens from Redis.

**Controller:** AuthController
**Method:** logout()

**Note:** This endpoint requires authentication. Include the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

**Response:** Success message string

Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.

**Controller:** AuthController
**Method:** refreshToken(RefreshTokenRequest)

**Request Body:**
- `refreshToken` (string, required): The refresh token obtained during login or registration

**Response:** AuthenticationResponse with new access token

item.description:
Authentication controller endpoints for user registration, login, logout, and token refresh.

**Base Path:** `/api/auth`
